name: 74119 · Tulsa, OK
findings: ZIP 74119 (Tulsa) has 120 nonprofit organizations. 56 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 44 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 74119 (Tulsa) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
36% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 74119 (Tulsa) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 15.7 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 32 organizations here; 43% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
